'''Ben Wehunt''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 1999 Phoenix tournament (Arizona Gamer)]] on 2 October 1999 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]], according to Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d66">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-06-az-gamer-phoenix-10-2-99d66/ az-gamer-phoenix-10-2-99], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 6 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-06-az-gamer-phoenix-10-2-99d66/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
